licence: Apache-2.0 for the official model repository and weights
parameters: 905,788,672 BF16 parameters including the speech tokenizer
precision: BF16 candidate on ROCm; FP32 fallback is not accepted as a silent provider change
cuda_or_triton_requirements: Official examples target CUDA and recommend optional FlashAttention 2. Use standard PyTorch SDPA on ROCm; do not enable the experimental AOTriton path, install the CUDA-only FlashAttention package or apply an HSA architecture override.
maintenance_status: Official Qwen checkpoint and package pinned from the current 12 Hz release; only built-in CustomVoice speakers are in scope.
